say:1:1622508001:1.text: You're here about the forest? Then you're talking to the right man. I made it out safe and sound!
say:1:1622508001:1.source_cn: 你们是来打听森林的事吗？我呀，是从里面安全走出来过！
say:1:1622508001:1.male: You're here about the forest? Then you're talking to the right man. I made it out safe and sound!
say:1:1622508001:1.female: You're here about the forest? Then you're talking to the right man. I made it out safe and sound!

say:2:1622508002:1.text: And don't pay attention to the things people say. All that talk about danger and whispers is nonsense. The forest isn't that frightening, and that big tree everyone fears... it's a gentle big fellow!
say:2:1622508002:1.source_cn: 外头传的什么禁语啊危险啊，都是胡说八道！森林一点儿也不...

choice_prompt:3:1622508002.text: And don't pay attention to the things people say. All that talk about danger and whispers is nonsense. The forest isn't that frightening, and that big tree everyone fears... it's a gentle big fellow!
choice_prompt:3:1622508002.source_cn: 外头传的什么禁语啊危险啊，都是胡说八道！森林一点儿也不可怕，那棵巨树更是个好家伙！

say:4:1622508003:1.text: Well, it all started years ago. My cat <style="highlight">Bibi</style> wandered off...

say:5:1622508004:1.text: Ah, Bibi... big amber eyes, fluffier than a dandelion. I still miss that little rascal...
say:5:1622508004:1.source_cn: 唉，我的包包啊，它那琥珀色的眼睛，毛茸茸的身子，像个小...

say:6:1622508005:1.text: Now where was I... right, the forest. I went in to look for my Bibi and got lost the moment I stepped under the trees. I was wandering around like a fool with no idea which way was which.
say:6:1622508005:1.source_cn: ……哎，刚说到哪了？哦对，我进了森林里找包包，结果一进...

say:7:1622508006:1.text: I kept going until I was dizzy and ready to give up. That's when I ran into the giant tree... and a kind fellow named Perri. They pointed me toward the right path, and that's the only reason I made it out.
say:7:1622508006:1.source_cn: 我兜兜转转、头晕眼花，正不知往哪走时，是巨树和一个叫皮...

choice_prompt:8:1622508006.text: I kept going until I was dizzy and ready to give up. That's when I ran into the giant tree... and a kind fellow named Perri. They pointed me toward the right path, and that's the only reason I made it out.
choice_prompt:8:1622508006.source_cn: 我兜兜转转、头晕眼花，正不知往哪走时，是巨树和一个叫皮瑞的好心人，给我指了路，我这才走出来。

say:9:1622508007:1.text: Of course I did! That thing is huge. You'd need a dozen people just to wrap your arms around it. <style="highlight">Deep-green bark</style>, leaves so thick they block out the sky. Feels like standing under a giant umbrella.
say:9:1622508007:1.source_cn: 当然！那棵巨树啊，粗壮得十几个人都抱不过来，<styl...

say:10:1622508008:1.text: And the bark has these deep lines. If you look closely, it's almost like an <style="highlight">old man</style> smiling down at you.
say:10:1622508008:1.source_cn: 树干上还有一道道纹路，凑近了看，像一张<style=h...

choice:8:0:1.text: So you really saw the giant tree yourself?
choice:8:0:1.male: So you really saw the giant tree yourself?
choice:8:0:1.female: So you really saw the giant tree yourself?

say:11:1622508009:1.text: Perri told me he was a <style="highlight">professor from the Lyceum</style>. Said the forest had a special kind of life energy and he came to study it.

say:12:1622508010:1.text: He treated that tree like an old friend. Claimed he could understand it too, knew its moods and all.
say:12:1622508010:1.source_cn: 他把巨树当老朋友，能听明白巨树的语言，懂它的脾气。

choice:8:1:2.text: And this Perri... who is he?
choice:8:1:2.male: And this Perri... who is he?
choice:8:1:2.female: And this Perri... who is he?

say:13:1622508011:1.text: No... Never did. But I never forgot the kindness Perri and the tree showed me that day.
say:13:1622508011:1.source_cn: 包包……终究是没找着。但我心里一直记着他俩的好。

say:14:1622508012:1.text: That's why I don't buy the scary stories. That forest isn't evil. Not to me.
say:14:1622508012:1.source_cn: 所以别人怎么说我都不信，那森林，明明是个善地。

choice:8:2:3.text: I see. And did you ever find your cat?
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 原来如此，你找到包包了吗？
choice:8:2:3.male: I see. And did you ever find your cat?
choice:8:2:3.female: I see. And did you ever find your cat?

choice:3:0:1.text: Then tell us what happened that day.
choice:3:0:1.male: Then tell us what happened that day.
choice:3:0:1.female: Then tell us what happened that day.
